scope: Internal inventory for a preliminary bounded cognitive-learning theory-plus-evidence manuscript and research packet. This is not an external review or an acceptance prediction. Empirical gates apply to the proposed empirical contribution; a genuinely original theorem-only paper needs a separately scoped gate set. File existence cannot establish a scientific claim.

gates.reason: FC1-FC7 define finite models, observations, acceptable actions, probe semantics, identity relations and resource scope. Internal proof/source review found no unresolved scope omission for these parent-owned propositions. This does not declare a complete theory of cognition.
gates.resolution_test: Bind every theorem to a declared finite class, observation and intervention semantics, admissible action set, identity relation and resource envelope; retain explicit misspecification and out-of-scope counterexamples.

gates.reason: Internal review supports the elementary scoped proofs, and distinct exact algorithms agree over the explicitly enumerated universes with source/result hashes checked. FC5c is a finite FC6 instance; FC6 otherwise has its conditional proof. FC7 has an algebraic proof but its separate numerical check remains proposed. This is parent-theorem reconstruction, not machine-formalized or external verification, general model validity, empirical efficacy or novelty.
gates.resolution_test: Review the actual proof dependencies and complete finite enumerations with a separate algorithm/checker; bind versioned statements to countermodels and results. Mark only the registered propositions closed, independently of novelty or empirical gates.

gates.reason: The donor map assigns the candidate learning forms to existing parents, including HEC/EC2 decision regions, ATMS, library learning and algorithm selection. The existing controller is parent-sufficient by construction; no unique theoretical or empirical residual is established.
gates.resolution_test: State one precise original residual with the strongest matching parent and a decisive falsifier, or formulate an original significant negative boundary. Do not promote terminology, elementary restatements or adoption of known mechanisms to novelty.

gates.reason: The earlier E2 pilot retains two dispatcher changes, no third change, bounded counted-work payback, no wall-time advantage and conventional-parent sufficiency. The new frozen E2 source-mask census retains all five arms: four correct arms, 15 stale single-deletion predictions, and an antichain parent using less counted work than explicit version-space learning. Saved arithmetic, predictions, raw query/shape receipts and snapshot record hashes were checked internally without rerunning source.
gates.resolution_test: Retain immutable failures, cost-model limitations and all denominators in any manuscript; this met reporting gate does not promote pilot evidence to confirmation.

gates.reason: The new pre-outcome frozen source-mask census supplies E2 development outcomes on previously exposed families, with given four-block grouping. It is not E3 confirmatory or disjoint replication. The exact mathematical calibration likewise does not establish empirical transfer.
gates.resolution_test: For empirical claims, freeze treatment, information permissions, independent units, endpoints, margins, analysis, stopping, negative twins and semantic holdouts; execute and report every registered outcome, then perform disjoint replication. A finite census must be described as a census, not pseudo-replicated population statistics.

gates.reason: The completed finite census includes equally informed antichain, eager-table and lazy-cache parents; the conventional antichain uses the least counted work among correct registered arms. This closes that bounded parent comparison as parent-sufficient. It does not establish matched adaptive trajectories for hidden-group acquisition, wider repair or any new headline residual.
gates.resolution_test: Compare the same observer interface, acquired structure, checker, memory and adaptation budget against exact/greedy decision-region control, alternative-support/antichain representation and lazy/eager memoized recomputation as applicable. Include learned-library transfer and compensated ablation; retain an exact tie as parent sufficiency.

gates.reason: New recorded source interventions and a removal counterfactual support within-method retention inference beyond exact cached masks. Supplied four-block grouping, monotonicity and human-authored learners remain explicit gifts; no hidden grouping or full replacement-rule discovery follows. Historical F1/F5/F6 fine traces remain unavailable and F2/F3 share a source receipt.
gates.resolution_test: Recover original probe traces for historical-cause claims or explicitly withdraw those claims. Separate new interventions from historical reconstruction; record origins and direct machine access; distinguish retention predicates, complete induced-rule identity and whole-function behavior.

gates.reason: Both pilots report bounded costs. New antichain acquisition/service uses 146401 counted operations versus 163066 for lazy caching, while active learning uses fewer queries at 436199 operations. The proxy does not count all host computation, and process time includes removal/scorer audits. Snapshot bytes are acquisition checkpoints: lazy service learns 240 entries without rewriting its snapshot, so final persistent storage is not matched. No full lifetime Pareto dominance or complete persistent-lifecycle claim is established.
gates.resolution_test: For a lifetime-frontier claim, measure and include acquisition, field construction, indexing, proposal/selection, checking, maintenance, storage, I/O and restart across matched arms. Preserve separate resource dimensions and quality gates; do not replace missing costs by zero or optimize a post-hoc scalar.

gates.reason: Code/results and internal checks are available, but this review is not external or authorship-independent reproduction. No complete fresh-host headline reproduction receipt is supplied in this packet.
gates.resolution_test: Produce a clean-environment source/dependency manifest, regenerate headline tables/figures from immutable raw outputs, and obtain a separate critical scorer/reimplementation or external reproduction appropriate to the claimed result.

gates.reason: A coherent prospective question can be framed, but the current engineering improvements and elementary parent-owned lemmas do not establish one original result of broad scientific importance.
gates.resolution_test: Demonstrate and explain a specific new phenomenon, significant theorem or rigorous negative boundary that matters beyond this project. A blueprint or reviewer simulation is not that evidence.

gates.reason: A full preliminary prose manuscript now includes abstract, populated source-study Results, Methods, Discussion, frozen-registration and raw-receipt links. The final changed abstract/results/availability sections were internally checked against the recorded census and preserve the claim ceiling. It is not a finalized submission: archive/environment and clean-host reproduction materials, final figure-source audit and accountable human declarations remain incomplete.
gates.resolution_test: Supply a complete coherent manuscript, claim/evidence map, nonspecialist summary, figure-source linkage, limitations and code/data availability materials; review them against the chosen venue's requirements at submission time.

gates.reason: This packet discloses internal AI assistance but does not supply accountable human claim owners, complete authorship/contribution decisions or final disclosures. Absence is not evidence of misconduct.
gates.resolution_test: Bind accountable human owners to scientific claims, record material AI assistance and source verification, and supply authorship, conflicts/funding and availability declarations appropriate to the eventual submission.
